crosswalk.name: answerSnapshotJSON
crosswalk.definition: Saved question wording, options, selected choice, revision and available learning-objective metadata. Version 2 adds the authoritative correct option after an accepted answer.
crosswalk.possibleValues: mq-answer-snapshot/2: prior version 1 fields plus gameID, objectiveID, objectiveLabel and correctOptionIndices (zero-based option positions, or null when unavailable). Version 1 remains supported without an answer key.
crosswalk.notes: The revision includes game identity, wording and option order. Original order requires a reliable shuffle mapping; otherwise optionOrder is displayed. Exact objective identifiers and labels are retained. Exam commits preserve the final saved selection and use that room’s question key.
crosswalk.caution: Correct options are saved only for accepted answers; drafts and rapid guesses carry no key. Conflicting keys for one revision are flagged for review. Authored choices contain no typed learner input or clipboard contents. Historical content is never reconstructed from current banks.
crosswalk.events: Local accepted answers, rapid guesses and exam drafts/revisions; private answer_evaluated events. Blank on lifecycle events.
